instruction.text: Drag the images to the correct group.

hint.text: The Equator runs through warm areas of both land and water. The North and South Poles are cold and icy places.

instruction.text: Areas close to the North and South Poles are very cold. Select one of the coldest places on Earth on this image.

hint.text: Look out for the white areas on Earth. These places are so cold that they are covered in ice!

instruction.text: Areas close to the Equator are very hot. Select one of the hottest places on Earth on this image.

hint.text: Hot areas can be both brown and green on Earth. It depends on whether they are more tropical or dry.

instruction.text: Iceland is close to the North Pole. Colombia lies on the Equator. Select the image of the colder country.
The South Pole is in Antarctica. Kenya lies on the Equator. Select the image of the hotter place.
